No. The 67.7 ha loss is dated 2020, so it falls before the 2020-12-31 cut-off, not after it. The evidence does not place it in the post-baseline period.

For 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31, Hansen GFC detected no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more across the whole asset, with valid observations over 100% of it. The only post-baseline loss was 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the 0.5 ha event threshold, so it is not counted as an event.

JRC data shows 0 ha of forest in 2020 on this 2,843.1 ha property.

Limits: changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. This also isn't a compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant or non-compliant, and it says nothing about periods outside 2021-2025.
